_note: Demo security advisories for AURORA watchdog. Entirely synthetic — not real CVEs.

advisories.title: DemoTrust Root CA Certificate Authority Compromise
advisories.summary: The DemoTrust Root CA has been compromised. All certificates issued by this CA should be revoked and reissued.
advisories.remediation: Revoke affected certificates and reissue from a trusted CA.

advisories.title: aurora-auth-lib versions < 2.0.0 — Authentication Bypass
advisories.summary: Versions of aurora-auth-lib before 2.0.0 contain an authentication bypass vulnerability.
advisories.remediation: Upgrade aurora-auth-lib to version 2.0.0 or later.

advisories.title: aurora-web-server versions < 2.0.0 — XSS Vulnerability
advisories.summary: aurora-web-server versions before 2.0.0 are vulnerable to stored XSS.

advisories.title: EnviroSense HVAC Firmware 4.x — Remote Code Execution
advisories.summary: EnviroSense HVAC firmware versions 4.0.0–4.2.x contain a remote code execution vulnerability.
advisories.remediation: Update firmware to 4.3.0 or later, or apply vendor patch.
